user_id.description: User ID must be a positive integer

action.description: Action to perform: add, edit, or remove a prompt; or list_tags to get distinct existing tags for reuse

id.description: Prompt ID (required for edit and remove actions)

title.description: Prompt title (required for add action, max 200 chars)

content.description: Prompt content (required for add action, max 10000 chars)

description.description: Description must be 2000 characters or fewer

tags.description: Tags to apply (each max 100 chars). Call manage_prompt with action=list_tags first to see existing tags and reuse them where possible.

pinned.description: Whether the prompt is pinned (pinned prompts sort first)
